Walk-in-Interview for Non-Teaching Posts
Walk-in-interview for appointing the Non-Teaching staff on Daily Wages/Contract basis in
Panjab University Constituent College, Nihal Singh Wala, Moga for the session 2023-24, will
be held on 23-24 September, 2023 at Panjab University Regional Center (Civil line, Near
Fountain Chowk, Opposite Pavillion Mall) Ludhiana.
Posts Details
Sr. No. Post Name Number of Post
1. Mali 02
2. Peon 02
3. Security Guard 02
Age/Qualifications/other Norms – as per Panjab University Chandigarh’s rules.
Interview Schedule
Walk in interview for Peon and Mali will be held on 23, September,2023(Saturday) as per
the following schedule:
Date Particular Time
23-09-2023 Attendance 09:00 am-10:00 am
23-09-2023 Document Verification 10:00 am – 11:30 am
23-09-2023 Interview 11:30 am onwards
Venue- University Institute of Laws, Panjab University, Regional Centre, Ludhiana.
Walk in interview for Security Guards will be held on 24, September,2023 (Sunday) as per
the following schedule:
Date Particulars Time
24-09-2023 Attendance 09:00 am -10:00 am
24-09-2023 Document Verification 10:00 am - 11:30 am
24-09-2023 Height and Chest Measurement 11:30 am – 12:30 pm
24-09-2023 Interview 12:30 pm-01:30 pm
24-09-2023 Race 02:30 pm
Venue- University Institute of Laws, Panjab University, Regional Centre, Ludhiana.
Sd/-
Principal
PU Constituent College
Nihal Singh Wala, Moga
Eligibility for Peon:
1. Essential Qualification: Middle Class Pass
2. Age: 18 to 37 Years
Eligibility for Mali:
1. Age: 18 to 37 Years
Eligibility for Security Guards:
For Civilian:
1. Essential Qualification: The candidate should be middle pass or above
2. Age: 18 to 37 years.
3. Physical requirements are folowing:
For Male Candidates
(a) Height-5’6” (2” relaxation for residents of Hilly/Tribal Area)
(b) Chest 32” with expansion of 1.5 (1-1.5”)
(c) A physical test will be conducted with a race of 1.5 km in 8 minutes (General)
For Female Candidates
(a) Height-5’2” (2” relaxation for residents of Hilly/Tribal Area)
(b) A physical test will be conducted with a race of 500 meter in 4 minutes
For Ex-Serviceman
1. Ex-Serviceman, Sepoy, L/NK and above from combatant Force only.
2. Character: Exemplary.
3. Educational Qualification- Minimum Middle Class Pass.
4. Age- 18 to 45 Years.
5. Height: No requirement for height for Ex-Servicemen.
6. Race: 1 km in 10 minutes
7. The incumbents will have to undergo a physical and medical test with eye sight as at 6x6
with spectacles.
NOTE:
1. Relaxation in Upper age limit as per Panjab University Chandigarh Norms.
2. All the applicants should bring the hard copy of the duly filled performa attached in this
notice.
3. Applicants must clearly state the job for which he/she is submitting his/her request in the
application (otherwise application will be rejected).
4. Separate Application Form for each category has to be filled.
5. Candidates are required to bring all original certificates proving all the claims regarding
qualification, caste, Age etc. photocopy of one complete set of all such certificates is also
required to be brought at the time of intertview/test.
6. No. TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.
